done_when: The commit forge upgrade writes carries a Proof list paragraph that names the upgrade fix's Done-when and its evidence (the pinned release set in forge.toml, the release's own forge sync, and close's test run), so the upgrade's first review gets a proof list; a command test runs forge upgrade on a new repo and on one adopted on an earlier release and shows the commit's paragraph reaching close's review; new client repos get it on their first upgrade and existing ones on upgrades run from this release on
why: A client's forge upgrade fix fails its first review with 'Not done: proof list', because the commit forge upgrade writes has no Proof list paragraph and nobody else commits to that fix (reported by a client session on v1.2.7)
